title: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final background art for a tranquil coastal exploration and fishing game's title menu. A breathtaking painterly illustrated sea at blue hour, warm ivory crescent moon high above a distant small island with a single lighthouse glowing amber, tiny wooden fishing skiff near the lower right, constellations and a few delicate gold chart lines, faint bioluminescent currents. Sophisticated hand-painted gouache and watercolor on subtly textured paper, atmospheric and poetic, cinematic composition with restrained detail. Wide landscape 16:9. Left 45 percent is quiet deep midnight navy ocean and sky with soft tonal depth, intentionally clear for large Chinese title and menu overlay, main island and moon on the right 55 percent. Deep ink navy, desaturated teal, antique gold, warm ivory accents. Elegant illustrated game art, not a website mockup. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no borders, no watermarks.
chapters: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original eight-tile chapter illustration atlas for a poetic coastal adventure game's illustrated journal. Draw a single 4 columns by 2 rows contact sheet with EIGHT equally sized landscape rectangular illustrations, edge-to-edge cells, hard straight grid boundaries, no gutters, no borders, no text. Entire image wide landscape 2:1 so each tile is also 2:1. Consistent refined gouache and watercolor, antique maritime naturalist field journal, ink navy and teal with warm parchment highlights and muted amber light. Top row left to right: 1) underwater silver fish school and red coral, 2) magnificent golden sailfish leaping at orange sunset beside channel buoys, 3) a sea turtle under clear turquoise water with sea grass, 4) coastal shell and a small driftwood log on sand at a rocky cove. Bottom row left to right: 5) windbell island with coastal windmills and warm lighthouse, 6) lush forest island mangroves and soft green lantern glow, 7) beautiful old wooden shipwreck on sandy shoal and pale waves, 8) moonlit ancient stone arch ruin with glowing star constellations. Each tile a complete polished scenic illustration, readable hero subject, visually distinct and matching the same artistic series. No writing, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no watermarks.
